{{I|the world around you.}} |auctionable = yes |tradeable=true |reforgeable=true |enchant = yes |museum = yes |museum_xp = 0 |museum_category = special |id=DUECES_BUILDER_CLAY |nbt={"id":159,"Count":1,"tag":{"HideFlags":254,"display":{"Lore":["§7§oA block that was used to build","§7§othe world around you.","","§7To: Unknown","§7From: Unknown","","§8Edition #0","§8January 1970","","§7§8This item can be reforged!","§c§lSPECIAL HELMET","Name":"§cDueces's Builder Clay","lore":["§7§oA block that was used to build","§7§othe world around you.","","§7To: Unknown","§7From: Unknown","","§8Edition #0","§8January 1970","","§7§8This item can be reforged!","§c§lSPECIAL HELMET"]},"ExtraAttributes":{"originTag":"ITEM_MENU","id":"DUECES_BUILDER_CLAY"}​}​}} '''The Builder's Clay''' is a {{Special}} [[Helmet]] and [[Collectable Items|Collectable]] item given by {{RN|a|Dueces|rank=false|ssm=true|prof=Kiwi}}, a former {{Rank|a|br=false}} of the [[Hypixel Network]]. When worn, it creates a ring of fire particles above the player's head. The Builder's Clay has been spotted in many {{Rank|a|br=false}}'s inventories, as well as given to a few players. According to signs on {{RN|a|rank=false|Dueces}}' island, The Builder's Clay might be given as a reward for a building contest he might hold in the future. == Obtaining == There were two ways for players to obtain the Builder's Clay: * By {{RN|a|Dueces|rank=false|ssm=true|prof=Kiwi}} himself visiting the player's island. If he thought the island looked well built, he would give one for free. * By visiting {{RN|a|Dueces|rank=false|ssm=true|prof=Kiwi}}'s island and paying him 10 billion coins, just like how players obtain a [[Dctr's Space Helmet|Dctr Space Helmet]]. == Gallery == File:Dueces's Builder Clay (worn).png|'''The Builder's Clay''' worn by {{mctxt|c|Dueces|size=10}} == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2021/June 07|link=none|'''Dueces's Builder Clay''' was first spotted being worn by {{RN|a|Dueces|rank=false|ssm=true|prof=Kiwi}}}} {{History|unknown|'''Dueces's Builder Clay''' was renamed to '''The Builder's Clay'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Special Items}} {{Nav/Armors}} [[Category:Hypixel Gifts]] [[Category:Helmet]]
